title: AURA: 面向机器人策略的恒定显存动作门控记忆
summary: AURA-Mem提出一种恒定大小的循环记忆与学习门控机制，仅在当前观测会改变下一步动作时才写入记忆，从而大幅减少写入次数。在合成基准测试中，准确率与最佳O(1)基线持平，写入次数减少5.19-6.13倍；在LIBERO-Long上，成功率达0.233，写入次数减少7倍，推理状态固定为4,224字节。
summary_en: AURA-Mem introduces a constant-size recurrent memory with a learned gate that writes only when the current observation would change the next action, drastically reducing writes. On synthetic benchmarks, it matches the best O(1) baseline in accuracy with 5.19-6.13x fewer writes; on LIBERO-Long, it achieves 0.233 success rate with 7x fewer writes and constant 4,224-byte inference state.
